title: DAVID CRAVER'S LONE PINE JUST UPDATED ITS STOCK PORTFOLIO
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Lone Pine just tore up its book: new $1.39B Amazon  
(\[AMZN\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/AMZN/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/AMZN/))) and $1.10B Danaher  
(\[DHR\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/DHR/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/DHR/))) stakes, and it's out of  
Seagate (\[STX\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/STX/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/STX/))) and Home Depot  
(\[HD\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/HD/)](https://tickeron.com/ticker/HD/))). What jumped out at you?  
  
Tickeron AI dug through Lone Pine's latest 13F and found a book that  
barely looks like last quarter's. They opened brand-new $1.39B of  
Amazon \[AMZN\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/AMZN/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/AMZN/)), $1.10B of Danaher  
\[DHR\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/DHR/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/DHR/)) and $908M of Meta  
\[META\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/META/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/META/)). Visa  
\[V\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/V/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/V/)) was boosted 1,243.52% and TSMC  
\[TSM\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSM/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSM/)) jumped 1,595.06%. They sold  
out of Seagate \[STX\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/STX/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/STX/)), Home Depot  
\[HD\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/HD/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/HD/)) and Linde  
\[LIN\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/LIN/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/LIN/)), and cut Nebius  
\[NBIS\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/NBIS/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/NBIS/)) by 64.05%.
